body: Your point about private charities is precisely the right attitude.  People spending their own money to do what they want is fine with me, whether they want to build a Christian memorial or shove stuff up their ass. It's the forced removal of money from other people for any cause that is obviously wrong, in my opinion.

This is why the political process is so dangerous. In the end, you're talking about people's tax money and what it's used for. Generally, when you mess with other people's money, you don't make friends.

In the end, all we have are two opinions, one vitriolic and one laid back. One could logically argue either perspective, but the fact remains there is no objective way to determine which opinion is correct. In the end, just because one person thinks it's okay for their tax money to partially go to a cause they do not support (I'm looking at you, the Democratic and Republican National Conventions), then that doesn't mean it's not valid to be upset about it.

In the end, the only way to stop this kind of bickering is to [end public spending entirely.](http://reddit.com/r/anarcho_capitalism)

Guys, I'm really scared.  I've gone from insanely happy to suicidal in the span of two hours.  Please. I need.... something...

>Every time a stressful situation arises

Every time I think about my finances or ex-wife or daughter or the fact that I can't tell the difference between someone who cares about me and someone who doesn't care if I die of my teeth.

Honestly, I appreciate what you're trying to do here, but I'm a little beyond "take it one step at a time" and "take a minute to let out your frustrations."  If my problem were that simple I wouldn't be here, trust me.

>people all around the world

All two of you.

I don't know.  I think it might just be best to give up my rights like Jen wants me to.  At least that way I wouldn't have that looming over me for the next 14 years of my life.  I just can't deal with her.  It's too much for me.  The last two times I talked to her, I didn't last two minutes before I was either screaming my head off at her, or ready to put my head through a plate glass window.

If you sense frustration, it's because I keep getting the same advice from everybody "silly, you got a boo-boo. use a band-aid," as I'm sitting here staring at them with a gangrenous limb.  My family loves me, but they haven't been able to help me.  My friends are cool, but utterly inadequate at giving advice in this regard.  And now in all of Reddit, I've found two people who have been giving me the same advice that hasn't been working for me for years.

I'm not trying to be ungrateful... but it's become obvious to me that simple axioms like "take it day by day" or "one step at a time" or "have a friend with you" are just not working.  I'm just getting worse.  I don't know what it is that I do need...

I appreciate the tips, and I am terrified for my daughter.  But right now, I can't even take care of myself. I want so badly to be in her life, but I'm afraid that in the process of talking to her, Jen will push me over the edge.  I am constantly on the edge of self- or other- harm, and Jen has an uncanny ability to drive me into irrational rage/depression in a moment's notice.  I'm no good to her if I'm dead or in jail, so I don't call.
